title: 1992 AHSME Problem 2
statement: An urn is filled with coins and beads, all of which are either silver or gold. Twenty percent of the objects in the urn are beads. Forty percent of the coins in the urn are silver. What percent of the objects in the urn are gold coins?

solutions.text:
Coins make up \(80\%\) of the objects, and \(60\%\) of the coins are gold. Thus gold coins make up \[ 0.80\cdot0.60=0.48=48\% \] of all the objects.

Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: First find the percent of all objects that are coins
Of those coins, use the complement of the silver percentage
